root_cause.finding: The lane1 cross-lane count exactly equals the accepted lane1 ACK count in both directions, while all accepted DATA frames are on the selected physical lane.
root_cause.rtl_mechanism: ACK decode forces lane_id_o to zero, but the cross-lane counter compares every accepted ACK as well as DATA against the physical lane. Therefore each legitimate lane1 ACK is falsely counted as cross-lane acceptance.
root_cause.local_source_observation: The local-source reject counter remained zero because per-module admission blanked the self echo before frame decode. Goal section 20 permits, but does not require, a positive local-source reject count; the positive blanked-raw counts and zero same-module accepted frames directly show the earlier suppression path.

required_remediation: Encode the ACK logical lane in existing reserved ACK header byte 11 bit 1 without adding airtime, and decode it into lane_id_o.
Keep the cross-lane counter fail-closed for accepted DATA and ACK frames.
Require the hardware admission-config readback to prove local-source rejection is enabled, but do not require its counter to be positive when the earlier quarantine path already blocks the frame.
Rebuild and freeze both endpoints and rerun all offline and hardware acceptance stages under a new authorization.
